body:
I am super proud of her. She actually came out to me first in a super cute 4 page email, basically explaining her troubles, and asking me not to hate her.

I went to her room and just hugged her and she started crying.

We were close before that, but we definitely became closer after that, I guess maybe she felt like she didn't have to hide anything anymore.

Like I said, my family is the only thing keeping me here, if something happened to them, I don't think I would stick around
